name: Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan
source:
You take control of a fledgling company in the fictional nation of Kashistan, armed with investment capital, an ambitious team, and twelve quarters (episodes) to prove that you can build something extraordinary.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5264830/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将在虚构国度卡什斯坦执掌一家初创公司，手握投资资金与一支雄心勃勃的团队，在十二个季度（章节）的期限内证明自己能够缔造非凡的商业传奇。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5264830/]Steam[/url]]
